answer: Spot-audit lottery stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits in the vault to earn. Each epoch a draw on the public knoll calls 4 in 100 identities to audit their history and funding. An ivory ball names each called identity; a fake cannot forge a coherent history, so it loses 70 plus a 40 penalty. Rented histories still pay 70 plus 40 per fake: 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 70 once and keep their share.
